map.📖 查看「舆情（监测/分析/报告）体系 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Public Opinion (Monitoring / Analysis / Reporting) System
map.每行输入一条「时段,正面,中性,负面」声量。总声量为三者之和，各情感占比＝该情感: Enter one line per "period,positive,neutral,negative" volume. Total volume is the sum of the three; each sentiment ratio = that sentiment volume ÷ total volume × 100%. The tool outputs the negative rate, the peak-volume period and the highest-negative-rate period, and gives a public-opinion attention level by negative rate.

map.公关与品牌团队按天汇总舆情声量，观察负面率变化，判断事件处置是否需要升级。: PR and brand teams summarize daily public-opinion volume, observe negative-rate changes, and judge whether incident handling needs escalation.

map.项目结案时用总声量、正面占比与负面率三项指标量化传播效果。: At project closure, use the three metrics of total volume, positive ratio and negative rate to quantify communication effect.

map.负面率多高需要预警？: How high a negative rate needs an alert?
map.工具按 15% 与 25% 两档划分：低于 15% 为可控，15%~25% 需关: The tool uses two tiers, 15% and 25%: below 15% is controllable, 15%–25% needs attention, reaching above 25% needs key handling; specific thresholds can be adjusted by industry.
map.本工具不判定文本情感，只对您已分类好的正面、中性、负面声量做汇总与占比计算，分类: This tool does not judge text sentiment; it only summarizes and computes ratios for the positive, neutral and negative volumes you have already categorized; the classification standard is up to you.
map.时段可以是任意粒度吗？: Can the period be any granularity?
map.可以，日、周、小时均可，只要每行按时段顺序填写且情感声量为非负数值。: Yes, day, week or hour all work, as long as each row is filled in period order and the sentiment volumes are non-negative numbers.
